title: Proposed change
description: Manifest at analysis/proposals/<id>/proposal.json. The runner copies .factory/ and AGENTS.md from path and leaves this file in the retrace repo.

change_type.description: Rank order is guardrail_hook, then skill or tool or custom_droid, then setting, then rule.

pr_url.description: Pull request that ships the proposal. Optional until the pull request exists. The dashboard links to it.
